fullDescription: A futuristic, AI-centric SaaS landing page design featuring a 'Cinematic Dark Mode' aesthetic. It utilizes glassmorphism, neon cyan and purple accents, and high-performance typography (Cabinet Grotesk and Satoshi). The design is optimized for developer tools, fintech, or AI-powered platforms. Layout highlights include a bento-style feature grid, a split-screen live code editor vs. UI preview, and a horizontal pipeline architecture visualization. It features interactive elements like 3D tilt-hover cards, floating background particles, and scroll-triggered reveals.

structured.summary: ConfigGen AI style guide: A high-fidelity, dark-themed UI system for technical SaaS products. It focuses on transparency, depth, and vibrant accent glows to create an 'intelligent' and 'premium' developer experience.

style.description: The style is defined by a deep navy background (#030712) with a subtle 40px grid pattern. It uses glassmorphism (12px blur, 10% white border) for all containers. Typography pairs heavy, industrial Cabinet Grotesk for headings with the geometric Satoshi for body text. The primary color is a vibrant Cyan (#00f2ff) paired with a deep Purple (#7000ff) in mesh gradients.
style.prompt: Create a futuristic dark-mode UI style. Background: #030712 with a 40px square grid in rgba(255,255,255,0.05). Primary accent: #00f2ff (Cyan); Secondary accent: #7000ff (Purple). Typography: Headings in 'Cabinet Grotesk' (900 weight, tight tracking), Body in 'Satoshi' (400-500 weight). Components must use 'Glassmorphism': background rgba(255,255,255,0.03), backdrop-filter blur(12px), border 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1). Interactive cards should include a 3D tilt effect: perspective(1000px) rotateX(4deg) rotateY(-4deg). Include a scanning 'glow-line' animation: 1px height gradient (transparent, #00f2ff, transparent) moving horizontally across containers. Buttons: Primary buttons should be solid #00f2ff with a 20px cyan shadow glow; Secondary buttons should be glass with white text.

layout_and_structure.description: A modular vertical layout starting with a floating glass header, followed by a hero section with 3D floating code snippets, an interactive split-screen editor, a multi-column feature grid, and a linear architecture flow visualization.

prompts.prompt: Design a fixed header at the top. Use a glassmorphic pill-shaped navigation bar (max-width: 1280px, padding: 12px 24px). Logo on the left with a gradient icon (#00f2ff to #7000ff). Center-aligned navigation links in text-sm #cbd5e1. Right-aligned CTA button in white with black text, rounded-full.

Center-aligned hero. Top-badge: glass pill with 'AI-POWERED' text and a pulsing cyan icon. Main Heading: Font-size 8xl, weight 900, with 'Apps from JSON' styled in a linear gradient (#22d3ee to #4f46e5). Below, a centered 16:9 glass container showing a dashboard mockup. Surround the dashboard with 'Floating 3D Snippets': small glass cards containing JSON or SQL code, animated with a vertical floating motion (±20px, 6s duration).

A two-column section. Left: A dark code editor (#0f172a) with macOS-style window controls and JSON syntax highlighting (Cyan, Yellow, Indigo). Right: A live UI preview window using glassmorphism. Between the two, include a progress bar with a 'Compiling...' status. Add a floating 'GEN AI ACTIVE' tag in the bottom right corner of the preview.

A 3-column grid of 'Tilt Cards'. Each card: 32px padding, 24px corner radius, glass background. Card icon: 48px square with 10% opacity colored background and a centered neon icon. Heading: text-xl font-bold. Body: text-sm #94a3b8. On hover, the card must lift and rotate slightly on its axis with the border-color brightening to #00f2ff.

A horizontal flow chart. Icons (JSON, CPU, Terminal, Rocket) connected by a dashed #334155 line. The central 'AI Runtime' node should be a 96px circle with a pulsing cyan glow effect and an inner spinning animation. Each node must have a uppercase text label below it.

special_ui_components.description: The primary container for feature highlights with a 3D interactive response.
special_ui_components.prompt: Implementation: Background rgba(255,255,255,0.03); Backdrop-filter: blur(12px); Border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); Transform-style: preserve-3d; Transition: transform 0.3s ease. Hover state: rotateX(4deg) rotateY(-4deg) translateY(-5px) and border-color: #00f2ff66.

special_ui_components.description: A decorative animation used to signify 'active' or 'intelligent' sections.
special_ui_components.prompt: Implementation: Create a absolute-positioned div 1px height, spanning the container width. Background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #00f2ff, transparent). Animation: translateX(-100%) to translateX(100%) over 3 seconds, infinite linear loop.
